peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 1.6% below its local comparables; 45 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (39.1): 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 100 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 999 yrs from 1882.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,610,000 ($1,603 psf, 979–1,205 sq ft; 9 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,614 psf (range $1,566–1,868); 0.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $11,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,350,000 ($1,775 psf, 1,323–1,334 sq ft; 9 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,668 psf (range $1,507–1,771); 6.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $142,000 more. 4-bedroom: median $2,600,000 ($1,701 psf, 1,517–1,528 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,902 psf (range $1,757–2,399); 10.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $307,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Cashew MRT about 290 m, Petir LRT about 620 m; closer than 405 of 462 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest Bukit Panjang Primary School about 540 m; more than 340 of 462 similar developments (the same as 68). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 840 m), more than 18 of 462 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre about 1,040 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 220 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Myst, 46 new sales, about 140 m; The Arden, 3 new sales, about 1,020 m; The Botany at Dairy Farm, 2 new sales, about 1,110 m; Hillhaven, 13 new sales, about 1,150 m; Narra Residences, 214 new sales, about 1,210 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 51 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 278 new sales and 512 resales (790 purchases); new sales were 35.2% of these purchases. Subsales (27) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dairy Farm Walk GLS site (Jan 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 980 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 512 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 93 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 512 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 519 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−1.3%). Planning-area private resales −27.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
